title: Influence of applying VARK learning styles on enhancing teaching skills: application of learning theories
reason: One-group pre/post laboratory-skills test after training via Facebook and WhatsApp posts, compared across VARK style groups. Achievement outcome of an intervention with no platform indicator or activity product analysed (E4); style is self-report.

extraction.country: Egypt (Mega Alfa labs; ethics approval 6th October University)
extraction.design: single-group pre/post, ANOVA by VARK style
extraction.n_quote: A research sample of 100 chemists working in Mega Alfa labs underwent online learning of laboratory parasitology skills via Facebook posts and WhatsApp dictated messages
extraction.population: newly graduated chemists in pre-employment laboratory training
extraction.outcome_or_construct: laboratory parasitology skills test; VARK learning-style preference (self-report)
extraction.notes: Secondary: NOREL (VARK style is a self-report questionnaire). Recoded NOREL -> E4 for consistency with 2-s2.0-85175355055 (same shape: one-group pre/post achievement test split by a style construct) under the logged E4/NOREL rule. Secondary: E3 possible (workplace trainees: 'chemists who are receiving training to be hired'), but not clearly non-vocational, so not applied. Style-group differences reported via ANOVA p-values only.
